text: Soft agreement: training is hourly (R$25/hr) until you pass; then salary R$4,000/mo. Either party may end during the trial window. Not CLT. KPIs may change with written notice.
Parties
1. How the phases work

START (may be mid-month)
    |
    v
TRAINING  — R$25/hr — until you pass the competency test
            (length = how fast you learn)
    |
    v
SALARY    — R$4,000/month — day after you pass
            (still in trial window)
    |
    v
COMMISSIONS eligible after one full month of work on salary
Trial window (mutual freedom): From start through the end of your first full month on salary, either party may end for any reason with written notice (email or message is enough).
2. Training period (hourly)
Pay: R$25 per hour, invoiced in BRL as PJ.
Mid-month start is fine — training pay is hourly, not a fraction of R$4,000.
Training ends as soon as you fully pass the competency check on: (1) mortgages basics for the seat, (2) software/tools, (3) ad account setup, (4) client onboarding, (5) managing an account.
Length depends on how long you take to learn — no fixed calendar end date.
Company confirms pass in writing. That note switches you from hourly → salary.
3. After training — salary (still trial)
Day after you pass: automatic move to salary R$4,000 / month (no longer hourly).
If salary starts mid-month: pro-rate by calendar days (R$4,000 ÷ days in month × days on salary).
You stay in the trial window until the end of your first full month on salary.
4. Commissions
No commissions during training.
On salary: eligible only after completing one full month of work on salary.
Commission rules are set separately when activated. KPI targets are subject to change with written notice.
5. Payday
9th of each month for the prior month’s approved hours and/or salary (and commissions when eligible), after PJ invoice.
Mid-month start: first invoice = hours × R$25 for training days (+ any salary days if you already passed that month).
6. What we expect
Show up, communicate clearly, be coachable.
Learn systems and the process we teach.
Ask before big account changes you are unsure about.
Help with creative/ad concepts as asked while learning.
Work toward KPI standards we set — standards may change with written notice.
Flag problems early.
Missing a KPI early = coaching. Ignoring process or going dark = either side may end under the trial window.
7. What this is not
Not CLT employment / not a guarantee after the trial window.
Not a lock on R$5k / R$6k / R$7k levels — those only if we continue later.
Not deep legal terms. Fuller agreement possible if we continue long term.
8. Ending during the trial window
Either party may end with written notice during training or the first full salary month.
Final pay = approved hours at R$25 and/or pro-rated salary for days worked.
Tool/account access ends on the last working day unless otherwise agreed.
9. Signatures
By signing, we agree on training pay, salary switch after pass, commission timing, and mutual exit during the trial window.
